content: Ngyɛɛl u mbwo a ngwɛɛl a Ndaa
Abun, làpiy nkyɛl yanswà, an'kwaar a ube manswà, mpem yweel yanswà, un'köl wanswà, anà ntwee yanswà.
Lànü bɛɛl aŋàpɔŋà là Ndaa asànaa baan a kɔɔ, ntɔn u mbwo a la, bɛ làyɛl ntɔn ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyakin, « bɛ lan'kyey naa Mwol wà ubwaŋ. »
Làsin tsütsü apà nde, nkɔŋ a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ayà bàpiy baar, wɛɛ ya yàŋàsɔɔl anà yàntal kusà a Nzam.
Bɛ ŋakwo làbilà asànaa nkɔŋ a mɔ̈ɔ̈ u ntööŋ a Ndwà ufàkal Dweelà, ntɔn mukyer itsuŋ a angaŋ a Nzam, ntɔn mukun'pà ibɔɔn in'kyɛɛl abyà ufàkyey Nde u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Ntɔn bàsön u Ndaa Aŋàsɔn naa:

content.text: « Le, mɛ an'sà nkɔŋ a twɛrà u Siyɔn,
nkɔŋ a ntal ayà kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l mɛ.
Mbuur awà asà làkyän amu ya, usàman anki nswɛn akà ikikye. »

content: Abun, ibyääl kye akà bɛ aŋàlàkwikilà, wɛɛ akà baar mpa abà aŋàlàkwikilà,

content.text: yàbulà nkɔŋ a isin, nkɔŋ a twɛrà.

content: Ya yà nkɔŋ mwey bàfàböl baar,
Baar abà bàfàbwà ba, ntɔn ba bàkyàtɔn musà làkwikilà amu Ndaa. Awà undiir kàkwe mukayɛɛl.

Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làbà itwà aŋàsɔɔl, itsuŋ a angaŋ amfum, un'sɛŋ in'kyɛɛl, un'sɛŋ kàwɛl Nzam ntɔn mukal wànde. Nde kàlabel mutoo u làpib anà muman pɛɛlà ande là ubem, ntɔn bɛ làkàkyään isal ande byà ibaŋ.
Itaan, bɛ làkäl anki un'sɛŋ, wɛɛ apanà, bɛ làbà un'sɛŋ a Nzam. Bɛ baar mpa làwɛl nsyääm, wɛɛ apanà, bɛ làkyàwal nsyääm a Nzam.
Làkäl asànaa asyääl a Nzam
Ankwen amɛ, mɛ amàlalɛɛl, asànaa alyaaŋ a mbwo anà angyey, twon lan'kal anà ilään a ndür abyà ifànwaan ità anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ.

Làkäl anà nkääl aŋàbwaŋ kusà a baar mpa abà Ayudà, ntɔn, unsà undiir nsil awà bàfàlatwee ba naa bɛ làbà baar abe, ba bàmɛn isal abɛ byàŋàbwaŋ anà ba bàsi Nzam làkoo kà ilä usàyà nde.
Làkäl anà unkyeey akà imfum a mɛɛn kyanswà, ntɔn Mwol, itàkal akà mfum awe anà ikɔ̈b a dudu,
itàkal akà an'kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r ufàtɔm nde mupà ntaaŋàmbar akà baar abe anà musyäŋà baar bàfàkyer ubwaŋ.
Ntɔn ba bà ukwen a Nzam naa bɛ làkyer ubwaŋ ntɔn mudübà min a insil mpa bàyöb akà undiir mwɛy.
Làkäl asànaa baar abye anà insaay, ukɔɔn asyääl kya asànaa nkümà ntɔn mufwe nkyɛl abɛ, wɛɛ làkyer asànaa asyääl a Nzam.
Làpɛ ibyääl akà baar banswà, lakwen atɔŋ abɛ, làyöb ikɔ̈b a Nzam, lun'syäŋà mfum.
Mbaan a mpay a Klistɔ
Asyääl a ndwà, làkäl anà unkyeey mbɔɔn akà ankum abɛ, kànà akà bàŋàbwaŋ anà bàduu mpɛl anki, wɛɛ anà akaŋitswumbuun.
Abun, yà ubwaŋ mbɔɔn mukyey mpay bàfipà ukɔɔn isin aya, ntɔn musyäŋà Nzam.
Abun, làkoo nà mukaŋ mpem naa bàladüb ntɔn ibii lan'kyer bɛ? Wɛɛ isàkal naa bɛ lan'man mpay ntɔn ubwaŋ lan'kyer bɛ, la là kab a ngway u mii a Nzam.
Kyekà, yà ntɔn ya waa bàlabel, ntɔn Klistɔ sye kàkɔɔm mwäänà ntɔn bɛ, nde kàlaswɛŋ mbaan ntɔn bɛ làläb nkääl ande.
Nde kàkyer anki man'be, ndaa a an'kwaar sye yàtoo anki u mun ande,
nde kàfuur anki in'tswe, mpal bun'tö in'tswe. Wɛɛ mpal bun'pɛ ba mpay, nde kàŋän anki, wɛɛ ya yanswà nde kàpɛ akà mbuur afàtsul nsaŋ a balàbal lanswà.
Nde kàsyen buur a man'be abi nde ŋakwo tii u kulunsi, ntɔn bi kàkü anà man'be abi ŋakwo, ntɔn bi ikäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn balàbal, nde kàlakɔɔr u mbwo a iwà ande.
Ntɔn bɛ làdiimà mbwo asànaa in'kɔk, wɛɛ apanà, bɛ lan'furà akàun'kyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk anà un'leer a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ.
